verdict.rationale: Sumsub ships a built-in AI assistant, Summy AI, with two documented functions. It can build and configure verification levels from plain-language requirements (sumsub-docs-36), and it can generate applicant overviews covering status, rejection reasons and next steps (sumsub-docs-40). These are narrow, single-purpose features rather than a general assistant you can hand arbitrary dashboard tasks to; the MCP server is for external agents and does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant that can carry out multi-step tasks across the dashboard (e.g., reviewing or approving applicants, AML or case actions), detail on how actions are confirmed or controlled, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
